datasets.name: ds_churn_tier_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
    risk_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_total,
    ROUND(AVG(churn_probability), 3) AS avg_churn_prob,
    ROUND(SUM(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS total_clv_at_stake,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_at_risk_90d), 2) AS total_revenue_at_risk
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE churn_prediction_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY risk_tier
ORDER BY CASE risk_tier WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 END

datasets.name: ds_churn_prob_dist
queryLines:
SELECT
    CONCAT(CAST(FLOOR(churn_probability * 10) * 10 AS STRING), '-', CAST(FLOOR(churn_probability * 10) * 10 + 10 AS STRING), '%') AS probability_bucket,
    FLOOR(churn_probability * 10) * 10 AS bucket_order,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS avg_clv_in_bucket
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE churn_probability IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY FLOOR(churn_probability * 10) * 10
ORDER BY bucket_order

datasets.name: ds_churn_by_state
queryLines:
SELECT
    customer_state,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN risk_tier = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_customers,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN risk_tier = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS high_risk_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN risk_tier = 'High' THEN revenue_at_risk_90d ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_at_risk_brl
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE customer_state IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY high_risk_customers DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ds_top_risk_customers
queryLines:
SELECT
    customer_unique_id,
    customer_state,
    ROUND(churn_probability, 3) AS churn_probability,
    risk_tier,
    ROUND(predicted_clv_90d, 2) AS predicted_clv_90d,
    ROUND(revenue_at_risk_90d, 2) AS revenue_at_risk,
    segment_name,
    ROUND(monetary, 2) AS historical_spend,
    frequency AS total_orders,
    churn_prediction_date
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE risk_tier = 'High'
ORDER BY revenue_at_risk_90d DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_churn_by_rfm
queryLines:
SELECT
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(churn_label_predicted) AS predicted_churned,
    ROUND(SUM(churn_label_predicted) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS churn_rate_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(churn_probability), 3) AS avg_churn_prob,
    ROUND(AVG(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS avg_clv
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE rfm_segment IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY churn_rate_pct DESC

datasets.name: ds_clv_tier_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
    clv_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_total,
    ROUND(SUM(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS total_predicted_clv,
    ROUND(AVG(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS avg_predicted_clv,
    ROUND(MIN(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS min_clv,
    ROUND(MAX(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS max_clv
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE clv_tier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY clv_tier
ORDER BY avg_predicted_clv DESC

datasets.name: ds_clv_by_state
queryLines:
SELECT
    customer_state,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS total_predicted_clv,
    ROUND(AVG(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS avg_predicted_clv,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN clv_tier = 'High Value' THEN predicted_clv_90d ELSE 0 END), 2) AS high_value_clv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN clv_tier = 'High Value' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_customers
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE customer_state IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY total_predicted_clv DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ds_clv_churn_matrix
queryLines:
SELECT
    clv_tier,
    risk_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS total_clv,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_at_risk_90d), 2) AS revenue_at_risk,
    ROUND(AVG(churn_probability), 3) AS avg_churn_prob
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE clv_tier IS NOT NULL AND risk_tier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY clv_tier, risk_tier
ORDER BY clv_tier, risk_tier

datasets.name: ds_top_clv_customers
queryLines:
SELECT
    customer_unique_id,
    customer_state,
    ROUND(predicted_clv_90d, 2) AS predicted_clv_90d,
    clv_tier,
    ROUND(monetary, 2) AS historical_spend,
    frequency AS total_orders,
    ROUND(churn_probability, 3) AS churn_probability,
    risk_tier,
    segment_name,
    ROUND(revenue_at_risk_90d, 2) AS revenue_at_risk
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
ORDER BY predicted_clv_90d DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_segment_overview
queryLines:
SELECT
    segment_name,
    cluster_id,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_total,
    ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2) AS avg_historical_spend,
    ROUND(AVG(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS avg_predicted_clv,
    ROUND(AVG(churn_probability), 3) AS avg_churn_prob,
    ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2) AS avg_orders,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score,
    ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 0) AS avg_recency_days
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE segment_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY segment_name, cluster_id
ORDER BY cluster_id

datasets.name: ds_segment_state_heatmap
queryLines:
SELECT
    customer_state,
    segment_name,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE customer_state IS NOT NULL AND segment_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_state, segment_name
ORDER BY customer_state, segment_name

datasets.name: ds_segment_feature_radar
queryLines:
SELECT
    segment_name,
    ROUND(AVG(R_score), 2) AS avg_recency_score,
    ROUND(AVG(F_score), 2) AS avg_frequency_score,
    ROUND(AVG(M_score), 2) AS avg_monetary_score,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score,
    ROUND(AVG(late_order_rate) * 100, 2) AS late_order_rate_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value,
    ROUND(AVG(customer_tenure_days), 0) AS avg_tenure_days,
    ROUND(AVG(churn_probability), 3) AS avg_churn_probability,
    ROUND(AVG(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS avg_predicted_clv
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE segment_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY segment_name
ORDER BY segment_name

datasets.name: ds_segment_clv_cross
queryLines:
SELECT
    segment_name,
    clv_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS total_clv
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE segment_name IS NOT NULL AND clv_tier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY segment_name, clv_tier
ORDER BY segment_name, clv_tier

datasets.name: ds_monthly_revenue
queryLines:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS active_customers,
        ROUND(SUM(p.total_payment_value), 2) AS total_revenue,
        ROUND(AVG(p.total_payment_value), 2) AS avg_order_value,
        SUM(o.is_late) AS late_orders,
        ROUND(AVG(o.actual_delivery_days), 1) AS avg_delivery_days
    FROM ecommerce.gold.orders_enriched o
    JOIN ecommerce.silver.vw_cln_ltst_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN ecommerce.silver.vw_payments_agg p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    WHERE DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') NOT IN ('2016-09','2016-12','2018-09','2018-10')
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM')
)
SELECT
    month,
    total_orders,
    active_customers,
    total_revenue,
    avg_order_value,
    late_orders,
    avg_delivery_days,
    ROUND((total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) * 100, 1) AS revenue_mom_growth_pct,
    ROUND(late_orders * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_orders, 0), 2) AS late_delivery_rate_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

datasets.name: ds_review_trend
queryLines:
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS avg_review_score,
    COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews,
    SUM(r.is_low_score) AS low_score_count,
    ROUND(SUM(r.is_low_score) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(r.review_id), 0), 1) AS low_score_rate_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five_star_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_star_count
FROM ecommerce.silver.vw_cln_ltst_orders o
LEFT JOIN ecommerce.gold.enriched_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') NOT IN ('2016-09','2016-12','2018-09','2018-10')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY month

datasets.name: ds_late_by_state
queryLines:
SELECT
    i.seller_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(o.is_late) AS late_orders,
    ROUND(SUM(o.is_late) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS late_rate_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(o.actual_delivery_days), 1) AS avg_delivery_days,
    ROUND(AVG(o.delivery_delay_days), 1) AS avg_delay_days
FROM ecommerce.gold.orders_enriched o
LEFT JOIN ecommerce.silver.vw_order_items_enriched i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE i.seller_state IS NOT NULL AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY i.seller_state
ORDER BY late_rate_pct DESC

datasets.name: ds_payment_mix
queryLines:
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    ROUND(SUM(p.credit_card_value), 2) AS credit_card_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(p.boleto_value), 2) AS boleto_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(p.voucher_value), 2) AS voucher_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(p.debit_card_value), 2) AS debit_card_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(p.total_payment_value), 2) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(p.credit_card_value) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(p.total_payment_value), 0), 1) AS credit_card_pct
FROM ecommerce.silver.vw_cln_ltst_orders o
LEFT JOIN ecommerce.silver.vw_payments_agg p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') NOT IN ('2016-09','2016-12','2018-09','2018-10')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY month

datasets.name: ds_c360_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS total_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN risk_tier = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_churn_risk,
    SUM(CASE WHEN risk_tier = 'Medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium_churn_risk,
    SUM(CASE WHEN clv_tier = 'HighValue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_customers,
    ROUND(SUM(predicted_clv_90d), 0) AS total_predicted_clv_90d,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_at_risk_90d), 0) AS total_revenue_at_risk,
    ROUND(AVG(churn_probability), 3) AS avg_churn_probability,
    ROUND(AVG(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS avg_predicted_clv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT segment_name) AS active_segments
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360

datasets.name: ds_action_cohorts
queryLines:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN risk_tier = 'High'   AND clv_tier = 'High Value'   THEN 'URGENT - Retain Now'
        WHEN risk_tier = 'High'   AND clv_tier = 'Medium Value' THEN 'High Priority - Win Back'
        WHEN risk_tier = 'Medium' AND clv_tier = 'High Value'   THEN 'Monitor - Growing Risk'
        WHEN risk_tier = 'Low'    AND clv_tier = 'High Value'   THEN 'Nurture - VIP Program'
        WHEN risk_tier = 'High'   AND clv_tier = 'Low Value'    THEN 'Low Priority - Cost Check'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END AS action_priority,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS total_clv_at_stake,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_at_risk_90d), 2) AS total_revenue_at_risk,
    ROUND(AVG(churn_probability), 3) AS avg_churn_prob,
    ROUND(AVG(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS avg_clv
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE risk_tier IS NOT NULL AND clv_tier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_revenue_at_risk DESC

datasets.name: ds_segment_risk_clv
queryLines:
SELECT
    segment_name,
    risk_tier,
    clv_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS customers,
    ROUND(AVG(churn_probability), 3) AS avg_churn_prob,
    ROUND(AVG(predicted_clv_90d), 2) AS avg_clv,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_at_risk_90d), 2) AS revenue_at_risk,
    ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2) AS avg_historical_spend,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_customer_360
WHERE segment_name IS NOT NULL AND risk_tier IS NOT NULL AND clv_tier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY segment_name, risk_tier, clv_tier
ORDER BY segment_name, risk_tier, clv_tier

datasets.name: ds_cohort_retention
queryLines:
SELECT
    cohort_month,
    months_since_acquisition,
    cohort_size,
    active_customers,
    retention_rate_pct
FROM ecommerce.gold.vw_cohort_analysis
WHERE cohort_month NOT IN ('2016-09','2016-12','2018-09','2018-10')
  AND months_since_acquisition <= 12
ORDER BY cohort_month, months_since_acquisition
